tracesTo: UserFlow: Commissioner League Linking & Admin Creation

stories.title: Generate Unique League Slug from League Name
stories.goal: automatically generate a unique URL slug based on the league name during league creation
stories.benefit: leagues receive a clean, readable URL (fshq.gg/LEAGUESLUG) without manual input
acceptanceCriteria: System converts league name to lowercase and replaces spaces with hyphens
System removes special characters and non-alphanumeric characters except hyphens
System limits slug length to maximum 50 characters, trimming from end if necessary
System queries database to verify slug uniqueness before assignment
Generated slug adheres to URL-safe character requirements (a-z, 0-9, hyphens)

stories.title: Handle Slug Collisions with Numeric Suffix
stories.goal: resolve slug conflicts when multiple leagues have similar names
stories.benefit: every league receives a unique URL even if league names are identical or very similar
acceptanceCriteria: When slug collision detected, system appends -2 to slug and checks uniqueness
If collision persists, system increments suffix (-3, -4, etc.) until unique slug found
System attempts up to 100 suffix iterations before throwing error
Original slug without suffix is always attempted first before adding suffixes
Collision detection occurs atomically to prevent race conditions during simultaneous league creation

stories.title: Display League URL to Admin After Creation
stories.goal: immediately see my league's unique URL after connecting my league
stories.benefit: I can share the league URL with members and verify it's correct
acceptanceCriteria: System displays full league URL (fshq.gg/LEAGUESLUG) prominently on league creation success page
URL is displayed as clickable link that opens league page in new tab
System provides copy-to-clipboard button next to URL for easy sharing
URL display includes visual confirmation when copied successfully
League URL is also visible in league settings/admin panel

stories.title: Edit League Slug as Admin
stories.goal: change my league's URL slug to something more meaningful or branded
stories.benefit: I can customize the URL to match my league's identity or fix awkward auto-generated slugs
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can access slug editing field in league settings page
System validates new slug follows same format rules as auto-generation (lowercase, hyphens, no special chars)
System checks uniqueness of new slug before allowing save
System displays clear error if new slug is already taken or invalid format
System requires admin confirmation before saving slug changes with warning about broken links

stories.title: Prevent Slug Changes After League is Active
stories.goal: limit slug changes to protect member access and prevent confusion
stories.benefit: league members don't lose access due to URL changes and bookmarks remain valid
acceptanceCriteria: System allows slug editing only within first 24 hours of league creation OR if no members have joined yet
After restriction period, slug field becomes read-only in admin settings
System displays explanatory message why slug cannot be changed after activation period
Exception: Site administrators can override restriction with special permissions
System logs all slug change attempts and history for audit purposes

stories.title: Set League Display Name and Avatar
stories.goal: customize my league's display name and avatar to reflect league identity
stories.benefit: my league has unique branding separate from the URL slug and external platform name
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can edit league display name independently from URL slug in league settings
Admin can upload custom league avatar image (JPEG/PNG, max 2MB, min 200x200px)
System displays avatar in navigation header, feed moments, and league pages
Display name defaults to external platform name but can be customized
Changes to display name do NOT affect URL slug

stories.title: Route to League via Unique Slug
stories.goal: access a league's home page directly using its unique URL slug
stories.benefit: I can navigate to the league with a simple, memorable URL
acceptanceCriteria: GET request to fshq.gg/{slug} resolves to correct league's home page
System returns 404 page with helpful message if slug does not exist
Invalid slug formats redirect to general error page with navigation options
Slug routing works regardless of user authentication state (respects league visibility rules)
System logs 404s on slug lookups to identify potential typos or removed leagues

stories.title: Display League Branding on All League Pages
stories.goal: see consistent league branding across all pages when navigating my league
stories.benefit: I have clear visual context of which league I'm viewing and feel immersed in league identity
acceptanceCriteria: League avatar appears in header/navigation on all league pages
League display name appears next to avatar in header
Feed moments tagged with league show league avatar and name
Public league pages show branding to visitors before login
Branding persists when switching between Feed, Matchups, Rankings, and other league sections
